title: Product Identity
description: Core product identification block used in all line items. A line MUST carry at least one identifier: GTIN (universal, required for pharmaceutical traceability and SICM), the buyer's ERP code, or the vendor's SKU. GTIN alone eliminates ambiguity between similar products (e.g. Amoxicilina 250mg vs 500mg); the other two are only unique within one party's ERP. / Bloque de identificacion de producto usado en todas las lineas. Una linea DEBE llevar al menos un identificador: GTIN, el codigo de ERP del comprador, o el SKU del vendedor.

gtin.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number — 13 or 14 digit EAN/UCC code. Venezuelan GTINs use country prefix 759. Mandatory for pharmaceutical traceability and SICM compliance. / Número Global de Artículo Comercial GS1. Los GTINs venezolanos usan el prefijo 759.

vendor_part.description: Vendor's internal SKU code. Used for ERP matching on the sender's side. Not universally unique — use GTIN for cross-ERP identification. / Código SKU interno del vendedor. Usado para conciliación en el ERP del emisor.

buyer_part.description: Buyer's internal ERP item code. Used for ERP matching on the RECEIVER's side, and it is the key a purchase order must return by: procurement is published against this code and the order posts back against it. Not universally unique — use GTIN for cross-ERP identification. / Codigo de ERP del comprador. Es la clave por la que la orden vuelve a su sistema administrativo.

brand_name.description: Commercial brand name of the product. / Nombre de marca comercial del producto.

description.description: Human-readable product description including active ingredient, concentration, and presentation. / Descripción legible del producto incluyendo ingrediente activo, concentración y presentación.
